title: American Honda Recalls 2022 All-Terrain Vehicles (ATVs) Due to Crash and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The vehicle's throttle cable can get stuck, posing crash and injury hazards. Units: About 2,900.

title: Conair Recalls Cuisinart Compact Blender & Juice Extractor Combos Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The nut holding the blender blade assembly can loosen and detach from the base when in use, posing a laceration hazard if a consumer comes in contact with a loose blade. Units: About 66,000 (In addition, about 1500 were sold in Canada).

title: eWheels Recalls Gotway and Begode Unicycles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The unicycle's lithium-ion batteries can ignite, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 500.

title: HABA USA Recalls Discovery Cubes Animal Hide and Seek Activity Toys Due to Choking and Ingestion Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The seam on the activity toy's house can open, allowing a young child access to the toy's filling, posing choking and ingestion hazards if placed in the mouth. Units: About 800.

title: JBR Solutions Recalls Aduro Surge Protectors Due to Shock and Fire Hazards
summary: The surge protectors contain incorrect polarization and poorly soldered connections, posing shock and fire hazards. Units: About 51,750.

title: Kubota Recalls Utility Vehicles Due to Injury and Collision Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The utility vehicle's steering shaft can shear at or near the electric power steering housing, and cause the driver to lose steering control, posing injury and collision hazards. Units: About 19,500.

title: Polaris Recalls RZR Recreational Off-Road Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: A fuel leak can occur at the fuel pump assembly joint on the fuel tank in close proximity to a hot surface, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 600 (In addition, about 7 were sold in Canada).

title: Summit Treestands Recalls Viper Level PRO SD Climbing Treestands Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The treestand's tree cable can dislodge from the cable assembly, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,555.

title: Target Recalls Cloud Island 4-Piece Plush Toy Sets Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The tires on the toy vehicles can detach, posing a choking hazard to children. Units: About 23,400.

title: Advantage Sales & Marketing Recalls Good Matters Three-Wick Candles Due to Fire and Laceration Hazards
summary: The candles can burn at higher than usual temperatures causing the jars to break, posing fire and laceration injury hazards. Units: About 30,100.

title: Crate And Barrel Recalls Thornhill Baby Cribs Due to Fall and Entrapment Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The mattress support pins can become loose or not fit properly causing the mattress to fall, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 280 (In addition, about 5 were sold in Canada).

title: E-Bikes Recalled Due to Fire and Burn Hazards; Distributed by Gyroor (Recall Alert)
summary: The e-bike's battery pack can ignite, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 3,300.

title: ESS Universal USA Recalls Mattresses Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard for Mattresses; Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The mattresses fail to meet the mandatory federal flammability standard for mattresses, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,800.

title: Gabby Recalls Fritz Mirrors Due to Injury and Laceration Hazards
summary: The ring and wire hanging mechanism can fail causing the mirror to detach and fall from the wall, posing injury and laceration hazards. Units: About 930.

title: Rosso Motors Recalls Youth Model All-Terrain Vehicles (ATVs) Due to Violations of Federal Safety Standards; Sold Exclusively on RossoMotors.com
summary: The Rosso Motors eQuad X and eQuad Q youth model ATVs do not meet mandatory federal safety standards. title: Samnyte Tattoo Numbing Creams Recalled Due to Failure to Meet Child-Resistant Packaging Requirement; Sold Exclusively at Amazon.com; Risk of Poisoning; Imported by Liu Xianli
summary: The packaging is not child resistant as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. The tattoo numbing cream contains lidocaine, posing a risk of poisoning to young children if they ingest it. Units: About 9,000.

title: SIMU Recalls Motors Sold with Awnings and Shutters Due to Shock and Electrocution Hazards
summary: The awning and shutter motor's power cable can disconnect while opened or closed manually (using the manual override feature), posing electric shock and electrocution hazards. Units: About 13,800 (In addition, about 12 were sold in Canada).

title: Sundance Spas Recalls Jacuzzi and Sundance Spas Brand Hot Tubs Due to Injury and Thermal Burn Hazards
summary: The temperature sensor can relay incorrect water temperatures and cause the water to be hotter than the set temperature, posing injury (heat stroke) and thermal burn hazards. Units: About 23,700 (In addition, about 5,400 were sold in Canada and about 40 were sold in Mexico).

title: AlEn USA Recalls Art of Green® Laundry Detergent Products Due to Risk of Exposure to Bacteria
summary: The recalled products can contain bacteria, including Pseudomonas aeruginosa, an environmental organism found widely in soil and water. title: 3M Recalls Scotch™ Thermal Laminators Due to Fire Hazard
summary: A safety feature can malfunction if the laminator overheats, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 516,500 (In addition, about 3,560 were sold in Canada).

title: Cordless Window Shades Battery Packs Recalled Due to Fire Hazard; Manufactured by Ningbo Dooya Mechanic & Electronic Technology Co.
summary: The battery packs can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 56,000 (In addition, about 1,450 were sold in Canada).

title: Ortal Recalls Gas Fireplaces Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Improper installation of the fireplaces can lead to problems with heat release and/or ventilation, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 400.

title: The Life is Good Company Recalls Darkest Blue Women's Fleece Sweatshirts and Men's Fleece Shorts Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard and Burn Hazard
summary: The recalled clothing fails to meet flammability standards for clothing textiles, posing a risk of burn injuries to consumers. Units: About 750.

title: Surf 9 Recalls Body Glove Tandem and ULI Inflatable Paddle Boards Due to Drowning Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Costco
summary: The glue on the inflatable paddle boards can separate at the seams and the paddle boards can deflate unexpectedly, posing a drowning hazard. Units: About 13,300 (In addition, about 7,000 of the Body Glove Boards were sold in Canada).

title: Yamaha Recalls Viking Off-Road Side-by-Side Vehicles Due to Crash and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: Improper installation of the retaining bolts could result in the parking brake mechanism failing to hold the vehicle when parked allowing the vehicle to move unintentionally, posing crash and injury hazards. Units: About 500.

title: ZLINE Recalls Gas Ranges Due to Serious Risk of Injury or Death from Carbon Monoxide Poisoning
summary: The oven of the gas ranges can emit dangerous levels of carbon monoxide (CO) while in use, posing a serious risk of injury or death from carbon monoxide poisoning. Units: About 28,000.

title: BLU3 Recalls Nomad Battery-Powered Tankless Diving Systems Due to Drowning Hazard for Divers
summary: The compressor head of the tankless diving system can fracture while in use resulting in restricted air flow, posing a drowning hazard for divers. Units: About 1,300 (In addition, about 20 were sold in Canada).

title: KTM North America Recalls GASGAS Off-Road Motorcycles Due to Crash and Injury Hazards
summary: An incorrectly programmed CDI box can lead to engine failure, posing crash and injury hazards. Units: About 231 (In addition, about 40 were sold in Canada).

title: Nova Medical Products Recalls Adult Bed Rails Due to Serious Entrapment and Asphyxia Hazards
summary: When the bedrail is attached, users can become entrapped within the bed rail or between the bed rail and the side of the mattress. This poses a serious entrapment hazard and risk of death by asphyxiation. Units: About 20,000.

title: Pacific Cycle Recalls Pacific Kids' Igniter and Pacific Bubble Pop 20-Inch Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Target
summary: The bicycle's handlebar can become loose during use, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 147,000.

title: Samsung Recalls Top-Load Washing Machines Due to Fire Hazard; Software Repair Available
summary: The washing machines can short-circuit and overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 663,500.

title: Target Recalls Children's Pillowfort Weighted Blankets Due to Asphyxiation Hazard; Two Fatalities Reported
summary: A young child can become entrapped by unzipping and entering the blanket, posing a risk of death by asphyxiation. Units: About 204,000.
